FAQ

Common questions.

Does it record or join my meetings?
No. Paste notes you already have — typed, or copied from a transcript.
What if my notes don't say who's doing what?
It only lists what's in your notes. Owners and due dates that weren't mentioned are left for you to fill in.
Is what I enter stored?
No. What you enter is used to write your result and isn't kept afterward. The only things Workblox Business saves are your business profile and, if you use it, your Contacts list. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Meeting Notes Cleaner is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
